items.title: COMP-6901-001 (Applied Algorithms)
items.body:
## Course Overview
- **Instructor:** Prof. H. Todd Wareham

## Current Status (Week 11 — Nov 17, 2026)
Currently covering **Polynomial-Time Intractability**: reductions, P / NP / EXPTIME, NP-hardness and NP-completeness.

### Completed
- [x] Lectures 1–16 (time complexity, CST/backtracking, D&C, DP, greedy, MST, BFS/DFS, shortest paths, reductions)
- [x] In-class Exam 1 — Oct 1 (got 76/100) 
- [x] In-class Exam 2 — Nov 5 (got 86/100)

## Upcoming: In-class Exam 3 — Thursday, Nov 26
**Format:** closed-book, on paper, 75 min, 50 marks
**Scope:** Lectures 9–16 (Topics 5–7)

| Question | Topic | Parts | Marks |
|----------|-------|-------|-------|
| 1 | Greedy / Graph Algorithms (Topics 5–6) | 3 | 30 |
| 2 | Polynomial-Time Intractability (Topic 7) | 3 | 20 |

## Next
- [ ] Lecture 17 (Nov 19): Cook/Karp, SAT → 3-CNF SAT, NP-hardness proofs
- [ ] Lecture 18 (Nov 24): Dealing with intractability (parallel, randomized, quantum, heuristics)
- [ ] Final exam prep: Prim's and DFS expected (not Kruskal/BFS, subject to change)

## Notes
The course diary is updated every lecture, so re-check the exam scope before each exam.

# Meeting 2026-11-18

**Attendees:** Oscar, Jay, Eduardo

## Agenda
- Discuss 2FA project deadlines and responsibilities.
- Review Eduardo's progress so far.

## Discussion
- **2FA project deadlines and responsibilities:** Eduardo will take over the 2FA project. First, he will replicate Peter's current setup. Then he will fix the communication/connection between the Meta Quest 3 and Peter's phone app. Jay will share a communication protocol from a previous project to help with the fix. The group also set target dates for the connection work and the user study, and discussed the ethics requirements (TCPS 2 certificate and whether the existing ethics protocol can be reused).
- **Eduardo's progress so far:** _[Add a brief summary of what you presented and any feedback received.]_

## Decisions
- Eduardo will replicate what Peter has done.
- Eduardo will fix the communication/connection between the Meta Quest 3 and Peter's phone app.
- Suggested deadline for the connection: middle of the Winter 2027 semester.
- Suggested deadline for the user study: end of the Winter 2027 semester.
- The 2FA project will count as Eduardo's project for Jay's course.
- Eduardo will complete the TCPS 2: CORE-2022 certificate by the beginning of the Winter 2027 semester.
- It needs to be checked whether the ethics protocol has to be updated or whether the one from the previous 2FA iteration can be reused.
- Jay will send Eduardo a communication protocol from a previous project to help with the fix.

## Action items
- [x] Send the communication protocol from the previous project to Eduardo — Jay — TBD
- [ ] Replicate Peter's current 2FA setup — Eduardo — TBD
- [ ] Fix the Meta Quest 3 ↔ phone app connection — Eduardo — Middle of Winter 2027
- [ ] Complete the TCPS 2: CORE-2022 certificate — Eduardo — Beginning of Winter 2027 (January 2027)
- [ ] Find out whether the ethics protocol needs updating or can be reused from the previous 2FA iteration — Eduardo / Oscar — TBD
- [ ] Run the user study — Eduardo — End of Winter 2027

## Next meeting
- Date: Wednesday, November 25, 2026
- Topics to bring:
  - Update on replicating Peter's setup (what works, what's blocking).
  - Update on the ethics protocol question.
  - TCPS 2 certificate progress.
  - Draft timeline from now to the user study.
